physical.notes: Physical Iron Monger endpoint contact. The proven VPX table changes endpoint state at motion start as an animation shortcut; a recreation must change it only when the moving assembly reaches the endpoint.

Physical Iron Monger endpoint contact. The proven VPX table changes endpoint state at motion start as an animation shortcut; a recreation must change it only when the moving assembly reaches the endpoint.

mechanisms.behavior: Four balls rest on occupancy switches 18-21. Output 1 ejects the rightmost ball through jam opto 22 toward shooter switch 23. The proven table pulses switch 15 as a software-only release confirmation, but the service manual proves physical switch 15 is Tournament Start; never create a trough-release switch at 15.
mechanisms.label: Four-ball trough

mechanisms.behavior: A ball on shooter-lane switch 23 can be launched manually or by output 2. This 2010 product uses the original multi-piece auto-launch assembly rather than the later Vault one-piece molding. Controller behavior is shared.
mechanisms.label: Manual shooter with auto launch

mechanisms.behavior: Each motor pulse toggles commanded lift direction. Switch 1 is fully down and switch 3 fully up; target faces 4-6 move with the toy. The proven table uses a 240-unit travel range completed over 62 update steps, moves the collision/flash geometry with the toy, and disables the three target faces while down. Output 3 applies a strong non-centering magnet force to a nearby steel ball. Keep endpoint sensing tied to actual travel, not the VPX shortcut that changes endpoint switches when travel begins. Retain the original 2010 multi-piece Iron Monger construction rather than the strengthened Vault molding.
mechanisms.label: Motorized Iron Monger lift, targets, and magnet

mechanisms.behavior: Output 4 applies non-centering magnet force near the two fixed Whiplash targets. The magnet has no position sensor and must influence ball motion physically rather than teleporting the ball. Retain the original 2010 Whiplash assembly rather than the strengthened Vault molding.
mechanisms.label: Whiplash magnet and target pair

mechanisms.behavior: Switch 10 is an opto in the War Machine capture. Output 5 kicks the captured ball back into play; the proven table ejects approximately toward 165 degrees with strength 55, which is a starting point for tuning rather than a controller requirement. Retain the original 2010 War Machine assembly rather than the strengthened Vault molding.
mechanisms.label: War Machine captured-ball kick back

mechanisms.behavior: Output 6 raises the orbit post when enabled and lowers it when disabled. There is no public endpoint sensor; model the collision post itself and use the controller state as the commanded position.
mechanisms.label: Orbit up-post

mechanisms.behavior: Output 12 raises the center-lane post when enabled and lowers it when disabled. There is no public endpoint sensor.
mechanisms.label: Center-lane up-post

mechanisms.behavior: Outputs 15/16 drive the left/right flippers. Public button/EOS pairs are 84/83 and 82/81; both EOS contacts are normally closed.
mechanisms.label: Lower flippers

mechanisms.behavior: Top-left, top-right, and bottom pop bumpers use output/switch pairs 9/30, 10/31, and 11/32.
mechanisms.label: Three pop bumpers

mechanisms.behavior: Left and right slingshots use output/switch pairs 17/26 and 18/27.
mechanisms.label: Lower slingshots

mechanisms.behavior: Output 8 drives the optional 16 VAC shaker kit from RED-WHT/J17-P7. The manual's Q8 table says 50 VDC, but its transformer/I/O schematics prove the 16 VAC feed. Treat absence as a valid factory configuration.
mechanisms.label: Optional shaker motor

mechanisms.behavior: Left/right ramps have entrances 12/43 and exits 49/37. Orbit rollovers are 7/9, spinners 11/14, center-lane spinner 13, top lanes 38/39, and lower outlane/return pairs 24/25 and 29/28. The proven table uses Hit/UnHit handlers for every wire-form route contact and Spin handlers only for the spinners; preserve sustained lane/ramp/rollover state rather than pulsing those contacts.
mechanisms.label: Ramp, orbit, lane, and spinner network

mechanisms.behavior: Seven fixed Iron Man targets occupy switches 33-36 and 40-42. Ground, Air, Tactical, and Sea drone targets are 44-46 and 50. These are static standups; the moving Iron Monger faces 4-6 and Whiplash pair 47/48 belong to their separate toy mechanisms.
mechanisms.label: Fixed Iron Man and drone target banks
